# Set up Fluentic in a React/Vite SPA

## Install

```sh
pnpm add @fluentic/i18n@beta @fluentic/i18n-web@beta
pnpm add -D @fluentic/i18n-cli@beta @fluentic/i18n-compiler@beta
```

For unpublished/local packages, use the project-provided beta.2 tarballs and package-manager overrides instead of registry versions.

## CLI configuration

Create `i18n.config.ts`:

```ts
import { defineConfig } from '@fluentic/i18n-cli';

export default defineConfig({
  compiled: true,
  catalogFormat: 'jsonl',
  output: 'i18n',
  languages: { source: 'en', targets: ['fr'] },
  files: {
    includes: ['src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}'],
    excludes: ['**/*.test.*', '**/*.spec.*', '**/dist/**'],
  },
});
```

Add scripts:

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "i18n:extract": "fluentic-i18n --config i18n.config.ts extract",
    "i18n:merge": "fluentic-i18n --config i18n.config.ts merge",
    "i18n:update": "fluentic-i18n --config i18n.config.ts update"
  }
}
```

Ignore only the disposable extraction cache:

```gitignore
/i18n/cache.local/
```

Commit authoring files and runtime catalogs unless deployment generates them elsewhere.

## Vite compiler

Merge Fluentic before React in the existing config:

```ts
import fluentic from '@fluentic/i18n-compiler/vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    fluentic({ config: './i18n.config.ts' }),
    react(),
  ],
});
```

Preserve all existing Vite options and plugins.

## TypeScript

For JSON manifests and Vite raw catalog imports:

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "types": ["vite/client"]
  }
}
```

## Runtime

Create `src/i18n.ts`:

```ts
import { defineTranslationLoader } from '@fluentic/i18n';
import {
  createLocalStorage,
  createTranslationCacheLoader,
  I18nManager,
} from '@fluentic/i18n-web';

const loader = defineTranslationLoader({
  en: [],
  fr: () => import('../i18n/translations/fr/merged.jsonl?raw'),
});

export const translationCache = createTranslationCacheLoader(loader, {
  hash: () => import('../i18n/translations/hash.json'),
  storageKey: 'my-app:i18n:catalogs',
});

I18nManager.configure({ languageId: 'en', fallbackLanguageId: 'en' });
I18nManager.setStorage(createLocalStorage());
I18nManager.setTranslationLoader(translationCache.loader);

export const initializeI18n = () => I18nManager.init();
```

Use an explicit loader entry for each language so Vite can discover lazy modules.

## Initialize before mounting

```tsx
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';
import { App } from './App';
import { initializeI18n } from './i18n';

const container = document.getElementById('root');
if (!container) throw new Error('Missing React root');

initializeI18n().then(
  () => createRoot(container).render(<App />),
  (error) => {
    console.error('Unable to initialize i18n', error);
    container.textContent = 'Unable to load the application.';
  },
);
```

Preserve existing StrictMode, router, providers, and error boundaries.

## Validate

```sh
pnpm i18n:extract
# Fill i18n/translations/fr/manual.jsonl
pnpm i18n:merge
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build
```
